items.title: Implement rate limiting per user
items.description: Rate limiting should be per authenticated user not per IP to handle shared networks

items.title: Add input validation for task creation
items.description: The create task endpoint accepts blank titles and negative priority values

items.title: Fix search not clearing on navigation
items.description: Search query persists when navigating away and returning to the task list

items.title: Migrate to structured logging
items.description: Replace System.out.println calls with SLF4J structured logging throughout the api

items.title: Add health check endpoint
items.description: Kubernetes probes need a dedicated health check endpoint for readiness and liveness

items.title: Fix API response caching headers
items.description: API responses are cached by browsers even for authenticated dynamic data

items.title: Improve table sorting UX
items.description: Clicking a column header should toggle sort direction with a visual indicator

items.title: Add automated backup schedule
items.description: Database backups should run automatically every six hours with retention policy

items.title: Fix session expiry handling
items.description: Users are not redirected to login when their session expires mid-action

items.title: Add request logging middleware
items.description: All api requests should be logged with method path duration and response code

items.title: Implement task duplication
items.description: Add a duplicate button so users can clone an existing task with prefilled fields

items.title: Fix broken pagination on mobile
items.description: Pagination buttons overlap on screens narrower than 400 pixels

items.title: Add task comments feature
items.description: Users should be able to add comments and discussion threads to tasks

items.title: Fix CSV injection vulnerability
items.description: Exported CSV files do not sanitize fields that start with equals or plus signs

items.title: Optimize database indexes
items.description: Query performance degrades as the task count grows beyond ten thousand rows

items.title: Add role-based access control
items.description: Different user roles should have different permissions for task operations

items.title: Fix memory leak in report generator
items.description: The monthly report generation process leaks memory and eventually crashes

items.title: Add keyboard shortcuts
items.description: Power users want keyboard shortcuts for common actions like create and search

items.title: Implement webhook integration
items.description: Add outgoing webhooks so external systems can subscribe to task events

items.title: Fix duplicate notification emails
items.description: Some users receive the same notification email two or three times

items.title: Add bulk task assignment
items.description: Allow managers to assign multiple tasks to a team member at once

items.title: Upgrade Spring Boot to 3.3
items.description: Current version 3.2 is approaching end of support window

items.title: Fix timezone display bug
items.description: Task timestamps show in UTC instead of the users local timezone

items.title: Add dark mode support
items.description: Users have requested a dark mode toggle for the dashboard UI

items.title: Fix stale data in reports
items.description: Cached report data sometimes shows stale numbers for up to an hour

items.title: Improve search performance
items.description: Database search queries are slow when the search term is short or blank

items.title: Add task priority sorting
items.description: Allow users to sort the task table by priority column

items.title: Fix email notification delay
items.description: Email notifications are delayed by up to 15 minutes after task assignment

items.title: Legacy API cleanup
items.description: Remove deprecated api helper functions and update search integration docs

items.title: Decommission legacy search endpoint
items.description: The old /api/v1/search endpoint should be removed after migration to the new api

items.title: Add API versioning
items.description: Public api should be versioned to allow backward-compatible changes

items.title: Fix status filter edge case
items.description: Selecting a status filter then clearing it does not reset the results

items.title: Optimize report generation
items.description: Monthly report queries take over 30 seconds and need optimization

items.title: Implement audit logging
items.description: Add audit logs for all write operations on the api endpoints

items.title: Fix search result ranking
items.description: Search results should prioritize title matches over description matches

items.title: Add loading skeleton UI
items.description: Replace the loading spinner with skeleton components for better UX

items.title: Update npm dependencies
items.description: Several npm packages have known vulnerabilities that need to be updated

items.title: Setup monitoring alerts
items.description: Configure alerts for api latency above 2s and error rate above 5 percent

items.title: Improve error messages
items.description: API error responses should include a human-readable message and error code

items.title: Fix pagination off-by-one
items.description: Page 2 shows the last item from page 1 as its first item

items.title: Add filter by date range
items.description: Allow users to filter tasks by creation date range on the dashboard

items.title: Cleanup old migration scripts
items.description: Remove migration scripts older than v2.0 that are no longer needed

items.title: Database connection pool tuning
items.description: Increase connection pool size and add monitoring for pool exhaustion

items.title: Report export CSV bug
items.description: CSV export adds extra commas for rows with empty description fields

items.title: Fix stale cache issue
items.description: Stale cache entries are served for up to 10 minutes after data changes

items.title: Refactor user service
items.description: The user service has grown too large and needs to be split into smaller modules

items.title: Add search to dashboard
items.description: Add a search bar to the main dashboard so users can find reports quickly

items.title: Update API rate limiting
items.description: Implement rate limiting on the public api endpoints to prevent abuse

items.title: Fix login redirect bug
items.description: Users are redirected to a blank page after login on mobile browsers
